name: spreadsheetToJson
description: Converts the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook to a JSON string: an array of row objects where row 1 supplies the keys (empty headers become column_N). When pretty is true the JSON is indented. The fluent member form is toJson(pretty).

params.name: pretty
params.description: True to pretty-print the JSON (default false).

examples.title: Sheet to JSON
examples.description: Export a sheet as a JSON array of row objects.
